analysis_set.span: Overall number of participants analyzed = full analysis set (FAS) which comprised all randomized participants. Number Analyzed = number of participants with available data.

follow_up.span: The co–primary end points, in the order planned for sequential hierarchic testing, were the percentage change in body weight and the proportion of participants who lost at least 5% of baseline weight by week 68

entry_age.span: Eligible participants were aged 18 years or older

notes: The served arm means describe available cases (373/189), but the served denominators are full-analysis-set totals (407/204). The full text states that efficacy analyses generally used all randomized participants; its treatment-policy analysis imputes missing data. That does not resolve the served row's mismatch. Week 68 is the outcome assessment; week 75 is the off-treatment safety follow-up. Entry criteria require overweight with a weight-related comorbidity or obesity and exclude diabetes, consistent with the question. Prior unsuccessful dietary efforts and additional exclusions narrow eligibility without placing participants outside that population.
